mapper.update: UPDATE MOCK_CERTIFICATES SET STATUS = 'REVOKED' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT CERT_ID AS certId, USER_ID AS userId, SERIAL_NO AS serialNo, PUBLIC_KEY AS publicKey, STATUS AS status, ISSUED_AT AS issuedAt, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt FROM MOCK_CERTIFICATES WHERE SERIAL_NO = #{serialNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT NONCE AS nonce, USER_ID AS userId, ACCOUNT_NO AS accountNo, SCOPE AS scope, CONSENT_TEXT AS consentText, USED_YN AS usedYn, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt FROM MOCK_CHALLENGES WHERE NONCE = #{nonce}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOCK_CHALLENGES SET USED_YN = 'Y' WHERE NONCE = #{nonce} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRES_AT >= SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_ID AS tokenId, USER_ID AS userId, ACCOUNT_NO AS accountNo, SCOPE AS scope, VALID_FROM AS validFrom, USED_YN AS usedYn, SIGNATURE_HASH AS signatureHash, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt FROM MOCK_CONSENT_TOKENS WHERE TOKEN_ID = #{tokenId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOCK_CONSENT_TOKENS SET USED_YN = 'Y' WHERE TOKEN_ID = #{tokenId} AND USED_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT BANK_TX_ID AS bankTxId, ACCOUNT_NO AS accountNo, TX_TYPE AS txType, AMOUNT AS amount, BALANCE_AFTER AS balanceAfter, COUNTERPARTY AS counterparty, TX_AT AS txAt FROM MOCK_TRANSACTIONS WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} AND TX_AT >= #{from, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND TX_AT <= #{to, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY TX_AT ASC
